info.name: TicketFlow API
info.description:
Requests and automated checks for the TicketFlow API.

1. Start the API (`dotnet run --project backend/src/TicketFlow.Api`).
2. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (or `npx newman run`), in order: the **Auth** folder stores the tokens the other folders use.

All accounts are fictional demo users from the seed.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Logs in one demo user per role and stores their tokens in collection variables.

exec: pm.test('Newest first by default', () => { const d = page.items.map(t => t.createdAt); pm.expect(d).to.eql([...d].sort().reverse()); });

item.name: List as requester: only own tickets

exec: pm.test('Every ticket belongs to the requester', () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.requester.id).to.eql(me)));

item.name: List as technician: assigned to me or unassigned

exec: pm.test('Assigned to me or unassigned', () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.assignee === null || t.assignee.id === me).to.be.true));

item.name: Filter by status and sort by priority

exec: const rank = { Low: 0, Medium: 1, High: 2, Critical: 3 };
pm.test('Priority descending (business order)', () => { const r = items.map(t => rank[t.priority]); pm.expect(r).to.eql([...r].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });

request.description: sort accepts createdAt, updatedAt, priority, status, title; "-" means descending.

item.name: 3. Tickets - lifecycle
item.description: Creates a ticket and walks it through the whole workflow, checking permissions on the way. The last request deletes it, so the demo data stays unchanged.

exec: pm.test('Open and owned by the requester', () => { pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('Open'); pm.expect(t.requester.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('requesterId'))); });

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Printer offline in warehouse",
  "description": "The warehouse printer shows offline on every computer.",
  "priority": "Low",
  "categoryId": 5,
  "branchId": 1
}

exec: pm.test('Clear message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Invalid status transition from Open to Closed. Allowed: InProgress.'));

item.name: Other technician can't see it anymore

exec: pm.test('History of every change', () => pm.expect(t.history.map(h => h.field + ':' + h.newValue)).to.eql(['Priority:High', 'Assignee:Carlos Rivera', 'Status:InProgress', 'Status:OnHold', 'Status:InProgress', 'Status:Resolved', 'Status:Closed']));
